title: Nightscout entries (read, permissive)
description: Generated by tools/nsschema/emit/jsonschema_emit.py from aid-entries-2025.yaml reconciled against reports/schema-census/entries.census.json. Do not edit by hand.

_id.description: MongoDB document ID (ObjectId as string in v1, any string in v3)

device.description: Source device identifier. Format varies by uploader.

direction.description: Glucose trend direction. Maps to rate of change:

filtered.description: Filtered raw sensor value. Used for calibration algorithms.

identifier.description: API v3 primary key. Server-assigned, immutable after creation.

isCalibration.description: Marks a reading produced by, or immediately following, a sensor

isReadOnly.description: Lock document permanently (HTTP 422 on modify attempts)

isValid.description: Soft-delete flag. false = document is deleted.

mbg.description: Meter blood glucose value in mg/dL.

sysTime.description: System time when reading was captured (Dexcom Share)

trend.description: Numeric trend code, written alongside `direction` by most

trendRate.description: Rate of change in mg/dL/min. More precise than `direction`.

unfiltered.description: Unfiltered raw sensor value. Used for calibration algorithms.

utcOffset.description: Timezone offset in minutes from UTC
